title: FLARE: Fine-Grained Diagnostic Feedback for LLM Code Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2606.03852v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models often generate code with bugs. Existing methods rely on feedback signals such as test failures and self-critiques to iteratively refine the generated code. Such signals are either too coarse-grained or too high-level, which is not sufficient to inform the model where to fix the bug. In this work, we present Flare, an iterative framework with a lightweight diagnostic model that predicts line-level suspiciousness signals for bug localization and code refinement. Given the inherent uncertainty of diagnostic predictions, Flare searches over the top-k suspicious regions and selects the best candidate according to execution outcomes. Experiments on LiveCodeBench and BigCodeBench with five base LLMs show that, even without candidate search (k=1), Flare outperforms the strongest baseline with an absolute improvement from 1.72% to 7.42%. Furthermore, searching over 10 candidates yields an average improvement of 8.5

translated_title: FLARE：面向大语言模型代码精炼的细粒度诊断反馈
translated_abstract: 大语言模型经常生成带有缺陷的代码。现有方法依赖测试失败和自我批评等反馈信号来迭代地精炼生成的代码，但这些信号要么过于粗粒度，要么过于高层，不足以告知模型应该在哪里修复错误。在这项工作中，我们提出了Flare，这是一个包含轻量级诊断模型的迭代框架，该模型可预测行级别的可疑性信号，用于错误定位和代码精炼。鉴于诊断预测固有的不确定性，Flare会在前k个可疑区域上进行搜索，并根据执行结果选择最佳候选代码。在LiveCodeBench和BigCodeBench上使用五个基础大语言模型进行的实验表明，即使不进行候选搜索（k=1），Flare也优于最强的基线方法，绝对提升幅度从1.72%到7.42%。此外，搜索10个候选平均可带来8.5%的提升。
tldr: FLARE提出了一种轻量级诊断模型，通过预测行级别的错误可疑性信号来定位并修复大语言模型生成代码中的缺陷，并借助候选搜索机制根据执行结果选出最佳修复方案，显著优于现有粗粒度反馈方法。
en_tdlr: FLARE introduces a lightweight diagnostic model that predicts line-level suspiciousness signals to localize and fix bugs in LLM-generated code, and leverages candidate search over execution outcomes to select the best fix, significantly outperforming existing coarse-grained feedback methods.
